blurb:
If you’re planning a trip to Ottawa, Canada and want to capture a truly unforgettable memory, our Flying Dress photoshoot is sure to be the experience you won’t forget. Picture yourself twirling in the wind, your dress billowing gracefully behind you set against the stunning view of Parliament Hill or other iconic Ottawa landmarks. 

Let your beauty shine at one of the capital's iconic locations. Some of the locations we love: Parliament, Dows Lake, Château Laurier, The locks, National Art Centre, Mackenzie King Estates, Major Hill Park

Prefer something different? Choose from numerous beautiful parks, lake views, walking bridges, graffiti walls, estates with ruins and so much more.
